desc:
🐺 You found a stray wolf at the edge of the woods. You named him Jerry.
Every morning, he leaves something dead beside your bed. 🦴

Someone uploaded a strange build of the game, then deleted it a day later. You installed it anyway. The world was already there... and so was Bob.

🌲 FEATURES
🐾 Tame Jerry with bones and keep him close
🛏️ Build a camp and survive until morning
🗺️ Follow Bob's map to his cabin, his grave and his log
🔦 Explore a huge blocky world of caves, forests and marshes
👥 Play solo or with up to 8 players
💀 10 endings to uncover
⛏️ Survival Mode: the same world, no story
🎨 Capes for you, collars for Jerry

Can you figure out what's wrong with Jerry before it's too late?

🎮 CONTROLS
WASD - Move | E - Inventory | M - Map
Left Click - Break / Attack | Right Click - Place / Use

👍 Like and favourite for updates!
⚠️ Contains jumpscares and blood. Play with the lights on.

Inspired by LookOut2DD's "Something Is Wrong With My Dog..."

badges.name: Welcome to the Woods
badges.desc: You came looking for Uncle Ray. A thin grey wolf in a red collar is watching from the treeline.

badges.name: Good Boy
badges.desc: Three bones, and he's yours. He follows you home. That's the problem.

badges.name: Morning
badges.desc: You lived until first light. Jerry is gone. By the bed there's one last gift: his collar.

badges.name: Put Down
badges.desc: You buried Jerry next to Bob. The world is quiet after that.

badges.name: Still Breathing
badges.desc: A whole night in Survival with Jerry out there, and you're still here in the morning.

badges.name: The Stray
badges.desc: He was gone by morning. You never learned his name.

badges.name: Bad Owner
badges.desc: You put him down before you knew what he was.

badges.name: Laid to Rest
badges.desc: Jerry found his way back to Bob.

badges.name: Off the Edge
badges.desc: You walked off the end of Bob's world.

badges.name: Pulled Out
badges.desc: You got out through the light.

badges.name: Left Behind
badges.desc: The way out closed. You're still here. So is he.

badges.name: The Last Gift
badges.desc: Everyone went down. Jerry brought you home.

badges.name: Sent Back
badges.desc: Bob's dog can rest now.

badges.name: Sweet Dreams
badges.desc: Sleep through a whole night in your own bed.

badges.name: Diamonds!
badges.desc: Find a diamond.

badges.name: Treat Time
badges.desc: Feed Jerry when he's hurt. Who's a good boy?

badges.name: Night Shift
badges.desc: Live through three nights in one game of Survival, with Jerry out hunting.

badges.name: Seven Days
badges.desc: Come back seven days in a row and claim the daily reward's seventh day.

badges.name: Good Dog
badges.desc: Love Jerry enough that he never turns.

badges.name: Left Hungry
badges.desc: Let Jerry go hungry until he leaves.
